item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Saturday 14 February In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Saturday, 14 February - politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Rain threat looms over India vs Pakistan clash in Colombo; Who stands to gain or lose?
item.description: Rain is expected to threaten the crucial India-Pakistan T20 match at R. Premadasa Stadium in Colombo. If the game between India and Pakistan is washed out, both teams may gain a point each and move closer to Super 8 qualification.

item.title: “Give Me 10 Minutes”: 19-Year-Old wins MBBS admission after aguing own case in Court
item.description: The Supreme Court of India granted provisional MBBS admission to a 19-year-old EWS student after he argued his own case, saying policy gaps should not deny eligible candidates opportunities.

item.title: Google marks Valentine’s Day with handmade gift doodle, showcasing love’s cultural roots
item.description: Google marked Valentine’s Day with a charming doodle celebrating handmade gifts, heartfelt notes, and sweet treats that symbolize love and care. The artwork was released across several countries, reflecting the global spirit of the occasion.

item.title: Why young Indians prefer Gold as top investment, Survey reveals
item.description: A nationwide survey by Smytten PulseAI shows Indian Gen Z and millennials increasingly favour gold as a primary investment, with most purchases under 5 grams and driven by personal financial decisions.

item.title: Nikhil Gupta pleads guilty in assassination plot against Khalistani Leader Pannu in US Court
item.description: Nikhil Gupta, accused of plotting the assassination of Gurpatwant Singh Pannu, pleaded guilty to three charges including conspiracy to commit murder and money laundering in a Manhattan federal court.

item.title: India improves passport ranking in Henley Index 2026 but loses access to Iran, Bolivia
item.description: According to the Henley Passport Index 2026, India’s passport ranking improved to 75th from 85th in 2025, reflecting stronger global mobility. However, the number of visa-free destinations decreased slightly to 56, down from 57, due to restrictions by Iran and Bolivia.

item.title: From Criminal Charges to Power: How three Bangladeshi leaders reclaimed politics
item.description: In a surprising political turn in Bangladesh, three leaders, previously facing serious criminal charges, have won seats in the new parliament. Lutfuzzaman Babar and Abdus Salam Pintu of BNP, along with ATM Azharul Islam of Jamaat-e-Islami, were cleared of all charges, including death sentences and terror-related allegations.

item.title: Assam: PM Modi witnesses IAF air show with Sukhoi Su-30MKI and Rafale at ELF Dibrugarh
item.description: The ELF is the first such strip in the Northeast and has been designed and constructed in coordination with the Indian Air Force. The main objective of this strip is to support the landing and takeoff of military and civilian aircraft during emergencies.

item.title: Box Office Update: ‘O Romeo’ opens to Rs 8.25 crore; ‘Tu Ya Main’ fails to impress
item.description: On opening day, Shahid Kapoor’s ‘O Romeo’ collected ₹8.25 crore, showing moderate performance despite high social media buzz. Romantic thriller ‘Tu Ya Main’ disappointed with only ₹55 lakh.
